🇮🇷 Iran rejects unrestricted IAEA inspections under threat of new strikes Iran will assess nuclear inspection requests case by case, weighing the security risks at each site, its envoy Reza Najafi told the International Atomic Energy Agency’s Board of Governors in Vienna. He said Tehran remains committed to its safeguard obligations and warned that information gathered during inspections could be used to plan another attack. 🗣 “Had they genuinely valued safeguards, they would never have attacked facilities already under safeguards for years,” Najafi said, referring to the June 2025 US and Israeli strikes. The US, Britain, France, and Germany pressed Iran on Thursday to let inspectors return to the damaged sites. In a joint statement, Iran, Russia, and China said full inspections could resume once hostilities end and Tehran receives credible guarantees against further attacks.
